question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "earliest."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **
 

__
 
• The word "earliest" means happening or done before the usual or expected time. (सामान्य या अपेक्षित समय से पहले घटित या किया हुआ)

 
 
• Example:* These data suggest that even the **earliest**__ multi-word utterances adhere to syntactic constraints.*

 
 
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that the initial visible indications of light damage are color fading and hue changes. 
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

One of the greatest __threats__ to textiles is light. It is a form of energy that can fade colour and cause chemical and physical __degradation__ of textile fibres. Exposure to both, natural and ultra violet light can threaten the __longevity__ of textiles. Light damage occurs progressively. You must have noticed at home that the most faded folds of curtains are the first to __shred__ and fall apart. Fading of colours and alterations of hues are the __earliest__ easy-to-detect signs of light damage. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Prompt: **immediate; done without delay. (अत्‍यावश्‍यक; बिना बिलंब किया (कार्य))
 
• **Premature: **happening before the normal or expected time. (सामान्‍य या प्रत्‍याशित समय से पहले घटित, समय-पूर्व)
 
• **Former: **of an earlier time; belonging to the past. (पूर्वकाल का; अतीतकालीन)
